description:
AI credits and export minutes left for the user in this workspace, and the plan. Call it only when the user asks about credits, limits or export minutes. Returns { credits, export_minutes, plan, cycle_ends_at }.

`credits` is { left (what the user can spend now), personal ({ allowance, used } for this cycle, when the workspace gives members an allowance), workspace_left, resets_at }. `export_minutes` is { used, limit, left } for this billing cycle; limit and left are null when exports are unlimited. A video counts once, at its longest export, so re-exporting it does not use more.
name: get_usage
title: Get Usage
